repositories.license: MIT wrapper; bundled Graphviz 14.1.3 EPL-1.0; current Graphviz upstream EPL-2.0
repositories.license_note: Exact Graphviz 14.1.3 COPYING was read from the official version tag and states Eclipse Public License v1.0. Official npm metadata states MIT for @viz-js/viz 3.25.0. Current upstream Graphviz is separately documented as EPL-2.0; do not infer historical terms from dates. The prototype distributes generated SVG, not the WASM engine. Future engine redistribution must preserve complete third-party notices for pinned versions.
repositories.proposed_use: 构建时图布局和 SVG 输出；同一两版本并集图只布局一次，原生 UI 切换显隐与样式
